2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch series standardizes the use of __nonnull_args() macro across the kernel by replacing raw compiler attributes in various functions. The changes are made to lib/list_sort.c and include/linux/list_sort.h, where nonnull attribute usage is unified and quirks are kept in one place.

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch series standardizes the use of the __nonnull_args() macro across the kernel, replacing raw compiler attributes for nonnull checks. The change aims to centralize attribute quirks and simplify coding style.
